description: bbs-sales quote-desk guards: no renames inside the tree, no near-duplicate buyer folders, FILLED/ is immutable; buyer precedent and open FLAGS injected at session start and again on the first write in a dated deal folder (which also lists quote-log rows older than 30 days with no final outcome for close-out). guard-tree and desk-context each ship as a PowerShell script and a Python script with identical behaviour (hooks/tests/parity.py, run in CI). Interpreter chosen by the shell Claude Code runs hooks through (Git Bash on Windows, sh on macOS): pwsh 7, else Windows PowerShell 5.1, else python3. With none of the three, the guard allows and returns a systemMessage the rep sees (stderr from a hook that exits 0 is shown nowhere), so a machine without a guard says so instead of looking guarded. desk-memory (SessionStart) adds what reps asked Claude to remember: LEARNED.md in the session's folder and each folder above it up to the tree, never a sibling's; parity proven by hooks/tests/desk_memory_parity.py. The same buyer notes also arrive on the first Read, Write or Edit under a buyer's folder, once per folder per session, through the existing PostToolUse entry (desk-context calls desk-memory in the same process). That entry's matcher includes Read for this, so it runs hooks/desk-post.sh first: one grep reads only the file_path, session_id and tool_name values, and the shell exits before any interpreter starts unless the path names the tree ("by Agency"), or when the Read is in a folder desk-memory already handled this session. A cwd inside the tree, or a file whose text says "by agency", does not count. rfq-record (PostToolUse) is a check after the write, not a block: the RFQ.md is already on disk, and on a problem exit 2 tells Claude what to fix. It has ONE validator, rfq-record-hook.py over scripts/rfq_record.py, so it runs python3 first (a working one: the Windows Store stub is skipped), then a Python 3 'python' (what the Windows bootstrap installs); it validates every RFQ.md written under the tree, compiles rfq-state.json beside it, and passes a v1-format record with a migrate notice. Without a working Python 3 the PowerShell half validates nothing: for an RFQ.md under the tree it returns the systemMessage 'RFQ record check needs python3; this edit was not checked' (hooks/tests/parity.py asserts it).

hooks.command: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tree.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tree.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-tree.py"; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"bbs-sales: the quote-desk folder guard did not run (no pwsh, powershell or python3 on PATH). This tool call went ahead unguarded. Rerun the bootstrap."}'; exit 0

command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/desk-context.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/desk-context.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/desk-context.py"; exit 0

command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/desk-memory.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/desk-memory.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/desk-memory.py"; exit 0

python3 -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/rfq-record-hook.py"; python -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] != 3)' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/rfq-record-hook.py"; command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/rfq-record-hook.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/rfq-record-hook.ps1"; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"bbs-sales: RFQ record check needs python3; this edit was not checked (no python3, pwsh or powershell on PATH). Rerun the bootstrap."}'; exit 0
